name: Table / Team Directory
description: Team Directory product scenario for the Table component.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the table when no visible heading does.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of the elements that name the table, such as the heading above it.

controls.name: columns
controls.description: Columns in display order; a column without a unique string `id`, or a group or separator, is dropped with a report.

controls.name: rows
controls.description: Row data, one object per row; a row that is not an object, or repeats a key, is dropped.

controls.name: rowKey
controls.description: Row key: a row field name or a function of the row, `id` by default. A row whose key is not text is keyed `#<position in rows>`.

controls.name: sort
controls.description: Controlled order of the rows: a sortable or any other column and a direction; `null` keeps the order of `rows`.

controls.name: defaultSort
controls.description: Order of the rows on mount (uncontrolled); read once.

controls.name: selectedRows
controls.description: Keys of the selected rows (controlled); keys without a row are kept and not shown.

controls.name: defaultSelectedRows
controls.description: Keys of the rows selected on mount (uncontrolled); read once.

controls.name: selectable
controls.description: Adds a leading checkbox column: one checkbox per row and a select-all checkbox in the header.

controls.name: rowNumbers
controls.description: Adds a leading column, headed by `labels.rowNumber`, that numbers the rows 1, 2, 3 in the order shown.

controls.name: stickyHeader
controls.description: Keeps the header row at the top of the nearest scrolling container.

controls.name: showDividers
controls.description: Draws a line under the header and under every row.

controls.name: stickyLastColumn
controls.description: Keeps the last column at the inline end of the nearest scrolling container while rows scroll sideways.

controls.name: resizable
controls.description: Adds a handle to each header cell that resizes its column by pointer or arrow keys; a resize fixes every column, so the table grows or shrinks. Turning it off restores the columns.

controls.name: activeRow
controls.description: Key of the row marked as the current one (`aria-current`), such as the row open in a detail view.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Outer membrane spacing around the table.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: `tile` shows each row as one rounded surface, under the pointer and when selected or current, with its content inset; `plain` keeps full-width rows.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names and text of the table's own controls; the table takes a native aria-label or aria-labelledby.
